newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Preston raises A$3.15 mln in placement.
newsitem.headline: Preston raises A$3.15 mln in placement.

text.p: Nickel explorer Preston Resources NL said on Monday it had raised A$3.15 million through the placement of 1.05 million shares at A$3.00 each to institutional investors.

Preston said the placement would ensure access to funds to allow the company to meet the budget requirements of its Marlborough nickel project feasibility study, expected to be completed by march 1998.
Marlborough is a lateritic nickel project located in central Queensland and is 100 percent owned by Preston.
